cards.card_text: Then comes another command: cut off the sower from Babylon, and the one who wields the sickle at harvest time.
cards.verse_text: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and the one who wields the sickle at harvest time.
cards.snippet: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and the one who wields the sickle at harvest time.

cards.card_text: With the sower and the reaper cut off from Babylon, the LORD says that in the face of the oppressor's sword, each one will turn to his own people and flee to his own land.
cards.verse_text: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and the one who wields the sickle at harvest time.
cards.snippet: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and the one who wields the sickle at harvest time.

cards.card_text: Same with the treader of grapes catching up to the sower of seed.
cards.verse_text: “Behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when the plowman will overtake the reaper and the treader of grapes, the sower of seed.
cards.snippet: …the plowman will overtake the reaper and the treader of grapes, the sower of seed.

cards.card_text: Then Jesus tells them to consider the parable of the sower, and friend, that 'call me' text finally gets its PHONE CALL!
cards.verse_text: Consider, then, the parable of the sower:
cards.snippet: Consider, then, the parable of the sower:

cards.card_text: Jesus says the reaper is already gathering a crop for eternal life, so the sower and the reaper may rejoice together.
cards.verse_text: Already the reaper draws his wages and gathers a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may rejoice together.
cards.snippet: …his wages and gathers a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may rejoice together.

cards.card_text: Paul says God is the One who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food.
cards.verse_text: Now He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your store of seed and will increase the harvest of your righteousness.
cards.snippet: Now He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your store of seed…

cards.card_text: God supplies seed to the sower.
cards.verse_text: Now He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your store of seed and will increase the harvest of your righteousness.
cards.snippet: Now He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your store of seed…
